endpoints.name: Salado Switch
endpoints.basis: OSM 'Salado Switching Station' (Oncor, 345 kV), consistent with Oncor's '1.2 mi NE of IH 35 & FM 2484'.

oncor-temple-to-salado.counties_basis: study area per Oncor project page (rebuild within existing ROW, entirely in Bell County; CCN not yet filed)
oncor-temple-to-salado.notes: Rebuild of existing ~15-mi line in existing ROW; also connects intermediate Knob Creek, proposed Paramount, and Fryers Creek switches (138 kV portion Temple-Fryers Creek). CCN filing anticipated Dec 2026; no docket yet.

endpoints.name: Lamesa Switch
endpoints.basis: OSM Oncor 'Lamesa Substation' (138/69 kV) sits 1.2 mi NW of the OSM SH 349 x US 87 junction (32.7073,-101.9270), matching Oncor's description.

endpoints.name: Faraday Switch
endpoints.basis: OSM 'Faraday Substation' (WETT, 345 kV) ~8.8 mi south of Gail, matching Oncor/WETT description.

oncor-lamesa-to-faraday.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 60083 case style: Borden and Dawson Counties)
oncor-lamesa-to-faraday.notes: Joint Oncor/WETT CCN, Docket 60083 filed 2026-08-21; 36.1-48.7 mi. Faraday is WETT-owned; OSM also shows Oncor Willow Valley 345 kV adjacent (32.6505,-101.3963).

endpoints.name: Mascho Switch (formerly Clearfork Switch)
endpoints.basis: Clearfork 345 kV switch is documented as adjacent to Andrews County South Switch; OSM 'Andrews County South Switching Station' (Sharyland/Oncor) sits ~2 mi SW of the OSM SH 115 x FM 181 junction (32.1820,-102.7488), matching the notice.

endpoints.name: Lamesa Switch
endpoints.basis: OSM Oncor 'Lamesa Substation' 1.2 mi NW of the SH 349 x US 87 junction, matching the notice.

oncor-mascho-to-lamesa.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 60082 case style)
oncor-mascho-to-lamesa.notes: Mascho Switch was formerly named Clearfork Switch (the endpoint of earlier Border-Clearfork project). Docket 60082 filed 2026-08-21; 60-80 mi.

endpoints.name: Border Switch
endpoints.basis: Planned switch not in OSM; placed ~6 mi south of the TX-NM line (32.000) and ~9 mi north of Quarry Field per Oncor; consistent with '7 mi SE of RM 652 & CR 300' (OSM RM 652 passes ~31.985,-103.73).

endpoints.name: Quarry Field Switch
endpoints.basis: OSM 'Quarry Field Switching Station' (Oncor, 345/138 kV).

oncor-border-to-quarry-field.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 57837 case style: Loving County)

endpoints.name: Drill Hole Switch
endpoints.basis: Placed from CCN notices ('~6 mi west of US 285, ~8 mi north of RM 652, near Culberson/Reeves line, end of CR 454'); an unnamed OSM 138 kV station sits at that point and is used as the coordinate.

endpoints.name: Border Switch
endpoints.basis: Planned switch; ~6 mi south of TX-NM line and ~9 mi north of Quarry Field Switch per Oncor; consistent with '7 mi SE of RM 652 & CR 300'.

oncor-drill-hole-to-border.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 58050 case style)
oncor-drill-hole-to-border.notes: Docket 58050 filed 2025-05-19; 34.4-39.1 mi. One line of Oncor testimony says Border Switch is 'in Reeves County' but all other Oncor text (and the endpoint answer in the same testimony) puts it in Loving County. Oncor sources variously say Drill Hole is 4 or 6 mi west of US 285.

endpoints.name: Drill Hole Switch
endpoints.basis: Placed from CCN notices ('~6 mi west of US 285, ~8 mi north of RM 652, near Culberson/Reeves line'); matches an unnamed OSM 138 kV station.

endpoints.name: El Capitan Switch
endpoints.basis: Planned switch; offset 5.6 mi NW from the OSM Seven L Rd x Rustler Springs Rd junction (31.7008,-104.2209) per Oncor; also ~17-18 mi SW of Drill Hole as Oncor states.

oncor-drill-hole-to-el-capitan.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 57828 case style: Culberson County)
oncor-drill-hole-to-el-capitan.notes: Docket 57828 filed 2025-03-20; 21-32 mi. El Capitan lies ~1 mi east of the existing OSM 'Culberson Substation' (31.758,-104.305). El Capitan is also an endpoint of El Capitan-Dry Lake 345 kV (Docket 59353).

endpoints.name: Drill Hole Switch
endpoints.basis: Placed from CCN notices ('~6 mi west of US 285, ~8 mi north of RM 652, near Culberson/Reeves line'); matches an unnamed OSM 138 kV station.

endpoints.name: Riverton Switch
endpoints.basis: OSM 'Riverton Switching Station' (Oncor, 345/138 kV), ~2 mi east of US 285 as Oncor describes.

oncor-drill-hole-to-riverton.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 58007 case style)
oncor-drill-hole-to-riverton.notes: Docket 58007 filed 2025-05-08; ~18 mi. Oncor page names only Culberson and Reeves, but the docket case style adds Loving.

endpoints.name: Dry Lake Switch
endpoints.basis: Planned switch; placed 5.4 mi WNW along FM 2119 from its OSM junction with CR 232 (31.5637,-103.8659), south side of FM 2119, per Oncor.

endpoints.name: Faulkner Substation
endpoints.basis: Existing OSM TNMP 'Faulkner Substation' (138 kV) sits ~3.3 mi south of IH 20 at Toyah, matching the description of the proposed 345 kV Faulkner Substation, which is presumably at or beside it.

oncor-dry-lake-to-faulkner.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 59487 case style: Reeves County)
oncor-dry-lake-to-faulkner.notes: Joint Oncor/TNMP; Faulkner is TNMP's. Docket 59487 filed 2026-03-24, ~24 mi. Companion TNMP Dry Lake-Faulkner 138 kV docket 59545. Dry Lake is also the endpoint of El Capitan-Dry Lake 345 kV (Docket 59353).

endpoints.name: Redland Switch
endpoints.basis: ERCOT calls the Redland 345 kV site 'Herty North (Redland)'; OSM 'Herty North Switching Station' (Oncor) lies 2.7 mi east of US 59 and ~3.8 mi NE of Lufkin, matching Oncor.

endpoints.name: Longleaf POI
endpoints.basis: Offset ~1 mi ESE of Redland Switch per Oncor (line length 1.63-1.78 mi); Longleaf Power Station not in OSM.

oncor-redland-to-longleaf.counties_basis: study area per CCN application (PUCT Docket 57553 case style: Angelina County)
oncor-redland-to-longleaf.notes: Endpoint is a point of interconnection (Longleaf POI) for the new Longleaf Power Station (dispatchable generation), not a substation. Docket 57553 filed 2025-01-30; planned completion April 2026.
